project: SFA3MR: Street Fighter Alpha 3 MAX Recomp
approach: Static recompilation of the PSP program to C with its own translator; PSP OS in HLE; SDL3 and OpenGL
notes: Every mode and character of the PSP release, with up to three local players (join-in on select screens, the network modes on one PC), restored L2 / R2 with per-player button configs, widescreen through the SFA3MAX 16:9 patch, everything unlocked and silent saves. Network play is not online.
